channel.title: The Local France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local France (thelocal.fr)

item.title: Record €150k fine for illegal Airbnb rental in Paris
item.description: 'It's the end of impunity', said Paris city authorities as they announced record fines of €80,000 and €150,000 for two Paris apartment owners who had rented their properties out on Airbnb without the correct authorisation.

item.title: Third British skier dies in another French Alps avalanche
item.description: A third British national has died in an avalanche in the French Alps, the latest in a succession of deaths across the area amid high-risk conditions.

item.title: Thousands march in France for slain far-right activist
item.description: Thousands of people marched in southeastern France on Saturday under heavy security in tribute to a far-right activist whose killing, blamed on the hard left, has put the country on edge.

item.title: On the Agenda: What’s happening in France this week
item.description: Former president Nicolas Sarkozy is back in court, MPs debate end-of-life care, the UK ends a tolerance period for its Electronic Travel Authorisation scheme, and France’s film stars get their best outfits out for the César Awards

item.title: French Word of the Day: Balles
item.description: Context is very important for this word, especially if someone asks you if you have any of these.

item.title: UK’s new passport rules for dual citizens are result of border control in digital age
item.description: New passport rules for British dual citizens reflect border control and citizenship in a digital age, writes Nando Sigona in The Conversation.

item.title: Hundreds rally in Paris to support Ukraine after four years of war
item.description: Around two thousand people marched in Paris Saturday to show their support for Ukraine, police estimated, just days before the fourth anniversary of Russia's invasion.

item.title: Endless rain, Montpellier, and growing up bilingual: 6 essential articles for life in France
item.description: We ask: will it ever stop raining? Plus, an explanation of why Montpellier is so popular with Americans, what it’s like growing up bilingual, how to challenge your 2026 mutuelle premium increase, and the hidden costs of selling your French home.

item.title: Macron asks Trump to lift sanctions on European officials
item.description: French President Emmanuel Macron recently wrote to his US counterpart Donald Trump asking him to lift sanctions placed on several European figures, including former European commissioner Thierry Breton and ICC judge Nicolas Guillou, according to extracts of a letter seen by AFP.

item.title: France to summon US ambassador over comments on slain far-right activist
item.description: The French foreign ministry will summon the US ambassador to Paris over comments made by the Trump administration about the killing of a French far-right activist blamed on the hard left, France's top diplomat said Sunday.
